Start here

Practical fixes for static sites, blogs, and beginner front-end work.

jquery.app is built for small jobs that should not require a login, a server, or a long tutorial. Pick the job, enter the values, copy the result, and paste it into your page.

SEO Tools Small browser tools for metadata, indexing, canonical URLs, social previews, and static site launch checks. HTML Tools Copy-paste helpers for cleaner HTML tags, head markup, snippets, and publishing workflows. CSS Tools Practical CSS generators for responsive layouts, spacing, mobile polish, and everyday UI fixes. Image & Asset Tools Client-side helpers for icons, image markup, asset paths, and static website files. GitHub Pages Tools Tools for custom domains, static publishing, launch checks, and GitHub Pages website maintenance.

Why this exists

Most tiny web problems are not AI problems.

Missing canonical tags, broken favicon paths, unsafe mobile padding, and messy social previews need a reliable tool that gives a clean answer fast.

No uploads No accounts No server-side processing Static hosting friendly
